thin-pi-adapter.decision: pi-gsd exposes a thin Pi adapter over package-local upstream GSD Core instead of duplicating GSD workflow semantics.

package-local-gsd-tools.decision: GSD commands are resolved through the bundled @opengsd/gsd-core dependency and package-local gsd-tools path.

pi-registration-boundary.decision: Pi tool and command registration is centralized in registerPiGsdCore while the entry point only defines schema and installs registration/guards.

optional-integration-detection.decision: Optional context-mode and pi-subagents behavior is detected at runtime rather than declared as npm dependencies.

model-routing-in-pi.decision: Pi-native model and thinking resolution is handled by model-routing logic and exposed through the gsd tool resolve-model action plus /gsd-model command.

node22-typescript-test-flow.decision: Validation uses TypeScript strict checking and Node's built-in test runner with strip-types on tests.
